scripts.dev: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d --wait db && concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web && npm run typecheck -w client
scripts.test: npm test -w server && npm test -w client
scripts.db:up: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d --wait db
